meta.title: Open Field Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Open Field Studio: free & open-source tool for inspection, handover and quality assurance in construction projects.

header.label: Inspection and handover
header.title: Open Field Studio
header.tagline: Inspect, hand over and record on the construction site
header.desc: Pin defects on the floor plan, work through a checklist and have the handover signed on screen. With photos, a dashboard and a report for every party, even without internet.

dashboard.alt: Dashboard with the number of tickets per status, category and assignee, and recent activity
dashboard.title: See at a glance what is still open
dashboard.desc: The dashboard counts tickets per status, category and assignee, flags overdue deadlines and keeps track of what happened recently.

tickets.alt: Survey: a ticket as a pin on the ground floor plan, with the ticket list next to it
tickets.title: Defects straight on the floor plan
tickets.desc: Load a floor plan, PDFs included, and pin each defect in the right spot. A ticket gets a category, priority, status and assignee, with photos attached. Filter by status, category or priority.

checklists.alt: Inspection with a checklist: pass, fail or not applicable per item, with a note
checklists.title: Fifteen checklists, ready to use
checklists.desc: From building surveys and the Wkb basic check to underfloor heating, ventilation and heritage buildings. Every item has the right input type: pass or fail, a choice, a measured value with unit, a photo or the NEN 2767 condition scale.

handover.alt: List of handovers, with a completed pre-handover
handover.title: Hand over with a formal record and signatures
handover.desc: Go through the items, give a verdict per ticket and have every party sign on screen. The handover record, with documents attached, is ready straight away.

reports.alt: Export project: choose a full project report, a punch list, an inspection report or a handover record
reports.title: A report for everyone
reports.desc: Create a full project report, a punch list of open tickets, an inspection report or a handover record, with photos and the marked-up floor plan. As PDF, HTML or BCF.

notice.text: Not production-ready yet: this tool is in development. You can try it out, but do not use it for real project work yet. Report what you run into on GitHub.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything for your round of the site
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

tickets.title: Tickets on the floor plan
tickets.desc: Defects and remarks as pins on the floor plan, with category, priority, status and assignment.

checklists.title: 15 checklist templates
checklists.desc: Pass or fail, choices, measured values with units, photos and the NEN 2767 condition scale.

energy.title: Energy label survey
energy.desc: All the data for a survey according to NTA 8800, in a structured checklist.

monument.title: Heritage inspection
monument.desc: Structure and envelope, historic interior, moisture and damage, and a maintenance plan with costs.

handover.title: Handover with signatures
handover.desc: A handover record with a verdict per ticket, documents attached and signatures on screen.

photos.title: Photos with time and place
photos.desc: Take photos from within the app. Each photo carries its time and GPS location, in the report too.

offline.title: Fully offline
offline.desc: Everything the app needs is built in. Your data stays on your own device.

mobile.title: On your phone
mobile.desc: An Android app and a layout that also works on a small screen, with large buttons.

bag.title: Look up address and energy label
bag.desc: Look up the address in the Dutch BAG register by postcode and house number, and fetch the energy label from EP-Online with one click.

ifc.title: IFC viewer
ifc.desc: Open an IFC model (IFC 2x3 or IFC4) and orbit, pan and zoom in 3D.

languages.title: Four languages, light and dark
languages.desc: Dutch, English, German and French, with a light and a dark theme.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Tickets per status, category and assignee, overdue deadlines and recent activity.

reports.title: PDF and HTML reports
reports.desc: Project report, punch list, inspection report or handover record, with photos and the marked-up floor plan.

bcf.title: BCF export
bcf.desc: Tickets as BCF 2.1 with photos, so you can follow them up in BIM software.

connectors.title: Connections
connectors.desc: Send a handover file to Woningborg, SWK, ERPNext or your own webhook, among others, and fetch project data and drawings.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download v0.3.9
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows and Linux, as an Android app, or right in the browser.
download.metaMac: There is no macOS version. On a Mac, you work in the browser.
download.mobileNote: On an iPhone or iPad, Open Field Studio works in the browser. Open it here.
download.browserNote: Rather not install anything? The app also runs fully in the browser, on any computer, tablet or phone.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.3
whatsnew.title: Connections in both directions
whatsnew.desc: Connections now have their own tab. You no longer only send files to them, you also fetch project data, contacts and drawings from them. The full list is in the release notes.

tab.title: Its own Connections tab
tab.desc: All connections in one place, showing for each one whether it has been set up.

import.title: Import a project
import.desc: Fetch a complete project from ERPNext or a webhook: name, number, client, address, contacts and drawings.

sync.title: Back to the source
sync.desc: When you save and when you complete a handover, the project file goes back to the linked project automatically.

desktop.title: Connections from the desktop app
desktop.desc: The installed app now also reaches systems that refuse connections from the browser.

update.title: Notice of a new version
update.desc: A notice appears next to the version number as soon as a newer version is on GitHub.

pdf.title: PDF export in the desktop app
pdf.desc: The report now opens straight in the print dialog; choose Save as PDF there.

ready.q: Can I use Open Field Studio yet?
ready.a: To try it out, yes, but not yet for real project work. The app is in development and not production-ready yet. Report what you run into on GitHub; that helps get it ready.

price.q: What does Open Field Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. The app is free and open source, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. No subscription and no licence fees per user.

offline.a: Yes. Everything the app needs is built in, and your data stays on your own device. Only looking things up in registers such as the BAG and sending to a connection need internet.

devices.q: Which devices does it run on?
devices.a: There are apps for Windows, Linux and Android, and the web version runs in any modern browser, including on an iPhone, iPad or Mac. The layout also works on a phone with a small screen.

data.a: On your own device. Photos, floor plans and signatures are stored locally. You save a project as a JSON file and load it again later, on another device too.

checklists.a: Fifteen templates, including a building survey, building services, safety, the Wkb basic check, underfloor heating, ventilation, an energy label and heritage buildings. Some use the NEN 2767 condition scale.

connect.q: Can I connect it to my own systems?
connect.a: Yes. You send a handover file to Woningborg, SWK, ERPNext or your own webhook, for example for n8n, among others. From ERPNext or a webhook you can also fetch project data, contacts and drawings.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A thin native shell in Rust for Windows, Linux and Android, with a small installer.

js.title: Vite and JavaScript
js.desc: A lightweight interface without a UI framework, which runs in any browser.

pdfjs.title: PDF.js
pdfjs.desc: Opens floor plans as PDF, bundled so it also works offline.

ifc.title: Three.js and web-ifc
ifc.desc: The 3D viewer for IFC models, as WebAssembly inside the app.

storage.title: IndexedDB
storage.desc: Photos, floor plans and signatures are stored locally, beyond the limited storage of the browser.

i18n.title: i18next
i18n.desc: Four languages; the app picks the language of your system and remembers your choice.
